I will grow this barley plot with the rains, not with irrigation, because here we depend on the season and this plot is small. I will use some chemical fertilizer if I can get it through the cooperative, but not too much, and I will also add manure or compost from the household. For seed I will keep to local barley seed that I know, and I do not expect to use pesticide or herbicide unless there is a serious problem. Most of the work will be done by my family, and I do not plan to hire labor.
